C0497.title: Jiangsu Police Uncover Face-Swap Software Scam for Unblocking WeChat Accounts
C0497.summary: In October 2021, Jiangsu police dismantled a criminal gang that used face-swap software to bypass WeChat’s facial recognition authentication. The suspects converted static photos into dynamic videos using multiple mobile apps, forged facial videos to successfully unblock over ten thousand WeChat accounts previously restricted for policy violations, and assisted fraud rings in using these accounts

references.title: Face-swap app unblocks tens of thousands of accounts for fraud, can facial recognition serve as definitive verification? - Tencent News
